text.p: Following is a factfile on former undisputed heavyweight champion of the world, Mike Tyson, who was banned and fined $3 million by the Nevada State Athletic Commission on Wednesday for biting Evander Holyfield's ears in the ring.
* June 30, 1966 - Michael Gerard Tyson born in Brooklyn, New York.
* 1978 - Aged 12, arrested for snatching a purse and sent to a remand home. In trouble as a teenager and expelled from highschool in 1982.
* March 1985 - Got professional career off to a whirlwind start with a first round knock-out of Hector Mercedes.
* November 1986 - Became youngest ever world heavyweight champion, aged just 20, by knocking out Trevor Berbick in the second round to win the WBC title.
* June 1987 - Charged with assault after allegedly hitting parking attendant who said he attempted to intervene when Tyson tried to kiss woman employee. Tyson paid $105,000 to settle out of court.
* August 1987 - Having defeated James "Bonecrusher" Smith to win the WBA title earlier in the year, Tyson outpointed Tony Tucker to become undisputed champion.
* February 1990 - Knocked out by James "Buster" Douglas in 10th round in Tokyo to lose world heavyweight title in one of the biggest upsets in boxing history.
* March 1992 - After being convicted of raping Desiree Washington, a Miss Black America contestant, Tyson sentenced to 10 years in prison, with four years suspended.
* August 1995 - Began boxing comeback, defeating Peter McNeeley in first round.
* March 1996 - Knocked out Briton Frank Bruno to regain the WBC title which he later relinquished. In September, knocked out Bruce Seldon to regain the WBA championship.
* November 1996 - Lost the WBA title to Evander Holyfield when referee stopped the fight in the 11th round. Afterwards, Tyson said he could not remember any of the fight.

* June 1997 - Disqualified in round three of rematch with Holyfield after biting a chunk out of the champion's right ear. Tyson also bit left ear, claiming Holyfield had headbutted him and opened a cut above his right eye.
